name: E2E-SEEDV-005 — 视频链路提交至下游20227(含入参校验)
description: 验证视频首帧选图后提交到下游视频审核链路20227,入参包含seller_id/seed_image_url/tao_cate/item_id,任务名称=种草视频_日期
module: 上游素材生产链路/种草视频链路

steps.description: [造数] 导航到商品管理页(获取cobweb API域+cookie)
[造数] 调用分层修改API将商品设为F0(触发TIER_TAG_CHANGED->种草生产)
[造数] 验证分层修改API调用成功

steps.expression: (() => { const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10).replace(/-/g,''); return { testType: 'upstream-rule-validation', scenario: '视频链路提交', pipelineId: '20227', inputParams: { seller_id: '${seedVideoSellerId}', seed_image_url: '视频首帧URL', tao_cate: '商品类目', item_id: '${seedVideoItemId}' }, taskName: '种草视频_' + today, strategyId: 10569, expected: { pipelineHit: true, allParamsPresent: true, taskNameFormat: '种草视频_yyyyMMdd' } }; })()
steps.description: 定义视频链路提交规格

steps.expression: (() => { const s = ${submitSpec}; const keys = Object.keys(s.inputParams); return { validation: '视频链路提交校验', checks: [ { name: '链路号', expected: '20227', actual: s.pipelineId, pass: s.pipelineId === '20227' }, { name: 'seller_id', expected: '存在', pass: !!s.inputParams.seller_id }, { name: 'seed_image_url', expected: '存在', pass: !!s.inputParams.seed_image_url }, { name: 'tao_cate', expected: '存在', pass: !!s.inputParams.tao_cate }, { name: 'item_id', expected: '存在', pass: !!s.inputParams.item_id }, { name: '任务名称格式', expected: '种草视频_yyyyMMdd', actual: s.taskName, pass: /^种草视频_\d{8}$/.test(s.taskName) }, { name: '策略ID', expected: 10569, pass: s.strategyId === 10569 } ] }; })()
